units.source_text: 这条腰带的花样和色彩，都是我隐居在尼姑庵里，经过十天半月的冥思苦想，才设计出来的。

en.t: I designed the pattern and colors of this obi only after shutting myself away in a nunnery and brooding over them for ten days or half a month.

units.source_text: 你看还算运用自如吧？”太吉郎说。

en.t: You can see that I have managed to use them rather freely, can't you?" Taikichiro said.
